changes_made.explanation: Verified that the extracted human evaluation information is correct and relevant. The paper clearly conducts human evaluations on WebNLG data.

overall_notes: This paper introduces BLEURT as a new automatic evaluation metric for NLG, not as an LLM judge. The main contributions are in developing and evaluating the BLEURT metric itself. The paper evaluates BLEURT on machine translation (WMT) and data-to-text generation (WebNLG) tasks, using both automatic metrics and human evaluations. The extraction was generally good but incorrectly interpreted BLEURT as an LLM judge rather than an automatic metric.
